judgement.reason: Development results oppose both benefits: mean total tokens rose from 906,258 to 1,600,156 (+76.6%), while success fell from 3/3 to 1/3. Mean elapsed time also increased by 28.2%. All 80 tool calls executed without errors, demonstrating operational execution, not improved task reliability. Failed trials used 25 and 43 calls; the successful trial used 12. Without baseline call counts or controlled comparisons, this does not establish causation. Replay outputs demonstrate descriptive measurements and explicit uncertainty, not task completion or token savings. Three seeds cannot establish generalization, and aggregate means lack variability estimates. Neither required benefit has supporting evidence, so stopping is not recommended.
